content_sections.heading: Maharajganj Anganwadi Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: A total of 305 vacancies (164 for Anganwadi Karyakartri and 141 for Anganwadi Sahayika) have been notified across 13 Anganwadi projects of Maharajganj district. The project-wise and category-wise break-up given in the notification is as follows. The notification also gives a category-wise (ST/SC/OBC/Unreserved) split of vacancies for every project, which is displayed on the notice boards of the Collectorate, Vikas Bhavan, District Programme Office, Tehsil, Nagar Palika/Nagar Panchayat, Development Block and every Anganwadi project office, and is also uploaded on upanganwadibharti.in. The department has also stated that the number of vacancies may increase or decrease.

content_sections.heading: Maharajganj Anganwadi Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Only women (female) candidates are eligible to apply for the Anganwadi Karyakartri and Sahayika posts. Minimum educational qualification: Intermediate (12th) or an equivalent qualification. Maximum educational qualification considered for merit: Postgraduate. The candidate must be a resident of the same Gram Sabha (for rural areas) or the same ward (for urban areas) for which she is applying; local residency is mandatory. At one Anganwadi centre, two women from the same family cannot be appointed as Karyakartri and Sahayika together. Widowed applicants: The husband's death certificate and an attested copy of the family register (parivar panjika) issued by the Gram Panchayat Officer or the concerned Nagar Nikay are required. Divorced/deserted (parityakta) women: A valid legal order issued by a competent court will be accepted. Income certificate: Only income certificates issued by the competent authority as per UP Revenue Department Government Order No. 3959/1-9-11-Raj-9 dated 30.09.2011 (as amended), and verifiable online, will be accepted. The income limit for the below-poverty-line category (rural and urban) will follow Samaj Kalyan Anubhag-2 Government Order No. 22/2015/2123/26-2-2015 dated 14.09.2015 (as amended). Residence and income/caste certificates must be digitally signed by the Sub-Divisional Officer (residence) and Tehsildar (income/caste) respectively, and must be verifiable online through the e-District portal. If the income certificate uploaded in the application is not verified online, the applicant will be treated as not belonging to the below-poverty-line category, and the selection process will proceed as per rules. If the caste certificate uploaded in the application is not verified online, the applicant will be treated as belonging to the Unreserved category for selection.

content_sections.heading: Maharajganj Anganwadi Age Limit
content_sections.text: Age will be calculated as on 01 July 2026. Only the date of birth recorded in the applicant's High School marksheet and certificate will be considered valid for determining age. Candidates should ensure that they fulfill the prescribed age criteria. Calculate your exact age using our Age Calculator before submitting your application to confirm your eligibility.

content_sections.heading: Maharajganj Anganwadi Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection will be made entirely on the basis of merit, following the procedure laid down in Shasanadesh No. I/2025/3313/58-1-2025 (1917687) dated 17.09.2025. No written examination or interview will be conducted for these posts. The entire selection process will be conducted online through the portal, as per the directions given in the government order. Merit will be determined on the basis of the qualification from Intermediate up to Postgraduate level. Marks obtained in High School will not be included in the merit calculation. To calculate merit, the percentage of marks obtained by a candidate is divided by 10. For example, 45% marks will count as 4.5 marks, and 59% marks will count as 5.9 marks. Marks obtained under grading or CGPA systems will also be converted and counted in the same manner. The merit list will be prepared by counting marks up to three decimal places; digits after the decimal will not be rounded off. If more than one eligible candidate is available in the same category, a merit list will be prepared for all such candidates. If any information, data, or marks entered in the application are found to be incorrect or fabricated, the candidature will be cancelled.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for Maharajganj Anganwadi Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Self-attested, clear and legible copies of educational certificates and marksheets (Intermediate to Postgraduate, as applicable), to be uploaded online as specified in the application form. Residence certificate, digitally signed by the Sub-Divisional Officer, verifiable through the e-District portal. Income certificate, digitally signed by the Tehsildar, verifiable through the e-District portal. Caste certificate (where applicable), digitally signed by the Tehsildar, verifiable through the e-District portal. Husband's death certificate and attested family register copy, for widowed applicants. Competent court order, for divorced/deserted (parityakta) applicants. No document or application will be accepted offline or by post. Selection will be based only on the documents uploaded online at the time of application.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Maharajganj Anganwadi Karyakartri & Sahayika Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the official Anganwadi recruitment portal: upanganwadibharti.in . Locate and open the online application form for Maharajganj district Anganwadi Karyakartri/Sahayika Recruitment 2026. Fill in the application form carefully and accurately in the prescribed format available on the portal. Upload self-attested, clear and legible copies of the required documents as specified in the online form. Review all entered details and submit the application before the last date. Keep a printout or digital copy of the submitted application for future reference. Applications must be submitted online only; no hard copy will be accepted at any level, including at the District Programme Office.
